title: Image updates
confirmHelp: Only {{component}} will be updated. The other component remains unchanged.
runtimeHelp: Runtime updates request immediate release. Submission does not confirm application health.
workerHelp: Existing sandbox sessions may keep their current Worker image. Create a new session to use the updated template.

phases.submitting: Update submission is in progress. Refresh status to reconcile.
phases.submitted: Submitted. Refresh status to verify the configured image and cloud status.
phases.uncertain: The update outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh status before another update.
phases.configured: Target image configuration confirmed. Application health still needs verification.

errors.forbidden: Permission denied. Check Studio management and AgentKit resource permissions.
errors.stale: Image configuration changed. Refresh status and select the version again.
errors.busy: The resource or an image update is still processing. Refresh status before updating.
errors.ownership: This resource must be exclusively owned and consistently bound to this MPA before it can be updated.
errors.missing_worker: No Worker template is bound to this Runtime.
errors.read_failed: Unable to read image status. Check the management database, cloud credentials and permissions, then refresh status.
errors.catalog_failed: Unable to load public image versions. Check registry connectivity and refresh versions.
errors.rejected: The update was rejected. Refresh status and check resource state and permissions.
errors.unchanged: The selected image is already configured. Choose another version.
errors.outcome_unknown: The update outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh status before another update; closing this dialog does not cancel a cloud update already submitted.
errors.invalid_image: Enter a complete image address, such as registry.example.com/namespace/image:tag. Do not include a protocol, credentials, or URL parameters.
errors.latest_resolution_failed: Unable to resolve or verify latest. Check public registry connectivity and version availability, then close and reopen this dialog to resolve again.

sourceHelp: Enter an image address or choose a public repository version. Using either clears the other.
